You are in a kitchen. An usual kind of place.

You can see a closed fridge, which looks conventional, nearby. You make out an oven. You see a table. The table is massive. On the table you can see a cookbook and a knife. Wow!   roast the yellow bell pepper

  fry the banana

  chop the red hot pepper
